decision_rule: Admit a zero-relvel strict wrong-history outcome corpus for objective-sanity only if M105 crosses source-diversity thresholds and M62 remains clean under identical miner settings.
failure_criteria: M105 selected rows cover fewer than 6 physical pairs or fewer than 5 seeds/source decision steps
M105 accepted rows require relaxed context distance above 0.05
M62 control has accepted outcome rows or exported snippets
the result is treated as driver success instead of corpus admission
hypothesis: M121's 30-episode zero-relvel strict run found a clean but under-diverse surface. A 60-episode repeat with the same thresholds may cross the diversity gate without relaxing context or admitting M62.
success_criteria: M105 selected rows cover at least 6 physical pairs
M105 selected rows cover at least 5 seeds and source decision steps
M62 control exports zero accepted snippets
